result.title: Zonotopic Analysis of Quantization Error in Neural Networks
result.summary: Quantized neural networks achieve computational efficiency by reducing precision, but bounding their quantization error remains a challenge due to discrete rounding and clamping operations. We present a zonotope-based abstract interpretation framework for quantized ReLU feed-forward network verification, introducing a unified round-clamp abstract transformer that jointly handles both operations. We extend this framework to constrained zonotopes, which add linear constraints to tighten bounds, and derive sound quantization error representations. We establish soundness and affine-strip optimality of the round-clamp abstract transformer, as well as convex-hull optimality of its complete constrained formulation. On the ACAS Xu benchmarks, our constrained zonotope method reduces average error-bound widths by approximately 70-85% and runtimes by 65-80% compared to QEBVerif's symbolic DRA propagation at the two smallest tested perturbation radii (r=3 and r=6). These improvements are not uniform across bitwidths, and symbolic DRA achieves tighter bounds at larger radii. Our plain zonotope method delivers competitive sound bounds nearly 300 times faster on average.

AI.brief_summary: 提出基于 zonotope 与 constrained zonotope 的抽象解释框架，用统一的 round-clamp 变换器对量化 ReLU 前馈网络给出可靠的量化误差界，并证明其可靠性、仿射带最优性与凸包最优性；在 ACAS Xu 上平均界宽较 QEBVerif 收窄约 70–85%，但该优势并非在所有位宽与大扰动半径下都成立。
AI.relevance_reason: 其集合式可达集与界传播可为核查 latent 推理状态在量化、多步更新下的误差累积与稳健性界提供工具线索，但与视觉推理主线距离较远，是否可迁移仍需核查。
